articles.summary: Chicago, July 10, 2024 /Globe Newswire/ — GoHealth, Inc. (GoHealth) (NASDAQ: GOCO), a leading health insurance marketplace and Medicare-focused digital health company, today announced changes to its Board of Directors. GoHealth welcomes Alan Wheatley, former President of Medicare at Humana, and Abhiraj Modi, Managing Director at Centerbridge Partners as its newest members of the Board, filling the […]
articles.title: GoHealth Announces Changes to Board of Directors
